new_design_claim: Primary candidate: source-state-specific diagonal joint-KV costs from normal-threshold-centered decision Jacobians, with equal attack weights, cost-specific assignments and coordinate centroids, followed by QCOC anchored closed-form value fitting. Same source seed IDs, at most 15 iterations, same slots, original N and exact source mass. Proposed; no real-model validation.
rejected_simplification: Averaging the diagonal Jacobian squares over source index into one shared head metric failed an exact six-partition synthetic example. It merged critical rare states just as ordinary normalized joint-KV clustering did. This is retained as negative design evidence, not tuned away.

synthetic_evidence.verified_by: Parent agent executed the pure synthetic check; this agent inspected code and stored results.
synthetic_evidence.scope: One scalar-output attention example and exhaustive 4-to-3 partition comparison; not full TabICLv2, QCOC value-fit evaluation or a guarantee for finite-iteration Lloyd optimization. Derivatives use individual source states; grouped duplicates are divided by their mass before sensitivity accumulation.

historical_retrieval_alternative: The retrieval-bank selection design is historical and inactive; it is not part of the current source-state-specific KV prototype design.
